subject: Anchored MAP: deployment cascade playbook & evaluation checkpoints
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Anchored MAP: deployment cascade playbook & evaluation checkpoints

Alex — attaching the anchored Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the first-pass evaluation prompt set for the post-signature rollout. Key proposal below; full details in MAP_MercuryHealth_v1.xlsx.

Summary (ask: please confirm next-week availability + any procurement blockers):
- Week A (canary): 2028-07-16 to 2028-07-18 — 10% traffic; health & quality gates defined in canary-gates.pdf.
- Week B (migration): 2028-07-21 to 2028-07-22 — primary traffic cutover; fallback window scheduled 24h after cutover.
- Week C (training): 2028-07-24 to 2028-07-26 — 2 days admin enablement + 1 day end-user training (train the trainer).
- Week D (eval & signoff): 2028-07-28 — acceptance run + regression eval (eval_prompt_set_v1.json).

Canary gates we’ll measure (metrics in canary-gates.pdf): latency P95, token cost delta, model-output regression against your key prompt set, and error rate on live routing. If any gate trips, automatic rollback to previous model variant + engineering on-call page.

Open items for MercuryHealth to confirm:
1) Which environment should we target for the canary (prod-read vs staging)?
2) Any mandated maintenance blackout windows 7/16–7/28?
3) Procurement contact for final PO and timeline (cc’d procurement@mercuryhealth.com if different).

Attachments: MAP_MercuryHealth_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), eval_prompt_set_v1.json (eval prompts).

I’ll set a 30-min pre-cutover call next Monday to walk the sequence and verification checklist once you confirm dates.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0124
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 02 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Anchored MAP: deployment cascade playbook & evaluation checkpoints

Ben / Alex — quick internal notes and one ask from ops: please consider splitting the Week B migration into a daytime dry-run (Friday 7/20) and a weekend final cut (Sat 7/22). That reduces risk for MercuryHealth operations and gives our infra team a recovery window.

I’ve attached a short gates doc that enumerates the exact pass/fail thresholds we’ll enforce for the canary. Also recommend the following minor changes to the MAP workbook before final sign-off:
- Add a rollback owner column (suggest: Rishi Malhotra).
- Expand the training agenda to include a 30-minute troubleshooting lab for the support team.

Attachment added: canary-gates.pdf (small PDF with thresholds).

If Alex agrees to the shifted migration plan, I’ll update the MAP and push a v2.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@mercuryhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@mercuryhealth.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 03 Jul 2028 08:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Anchored MAP: deployment cascade playbook & evaluation checkpoints

Thanks Ben — this looks tight but reasonable. A few items from our side before we lock dates: 
1) Data residency: our compliance team requires that any live inference traffic for PHI-like tokens is routed through our US-west region and logged to our KMS. Can you confirm the Private deployment option (VPC + KMS) will be available for the canary?
2) Procurement: we’ve started the PO but our standard 10-day review may introduce delays; procurement@ has the timeline.
3) Migration timing: we prefer the dry-run on 7/20 and final cut on 7/22 as Laura suggested.

If Redwood confirms the private routing & KMS integration by EOD Wednesday (07/04), I can commit to the July schedule and hit acceptance on 07/28. Otherwise we’ll need a 1-week slip.

Also, can you add a short appendix in the MAP that lists who on the MercuryHealth side is responsible for rollback and incident triage? I’ll populate names after sync with ops.

—Alex
Alex Mercer
VP Product Operations | MercuryHealth
alex.mercer@mercuryhealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@mercuryhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, procurement <procurement@mercuryhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Jul 2028 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Anchored MAP: deployment cascade playbook & evaluation checkpoints

Alex / team — thanks for the quick review and the procurement heads-up. Confirmations and next steps below: 

1) Private routing & KMS: Rishi confirms we can run the canary on your US‑west VPC with customer‑managed KMS keys. We’ll provide the integration checklist by EOD Wednesday (I’ve asked Rishi to post the checklist to the Drive folder).

2) Migration timing: accepted — dry-run Friday 2028-07-20; final cut Saturday 2028-07-22. I updated the MAP filename to MAP_MercuryHealth_v2.xlsx and attached it here for review.

3) Rollback owners / triage: Laura (CS) and Rishi (Infra) will be the primary rollback owners on our side; please add MercuryHealth names in the Appendix by Wednesday 7/11 so we can finalize call invites.

4) Procurement & PO: thanks procurement@ — once PO is received, we’ll release the final DocuSign signature packet. For visibility, the DocuSign packet is: https://www.docusign.com/en/signature/MH-MAP-0457

5) Pre-cutover call: scheduled for 2028-07-19 10:00 PT — invite to follow once the MAP v2 is accepted.

Attachments (referenced): MAP_MercuryHealth_v2.xlsx, canary-gates.pdf, eval_prompt_set_v1.json

If everyone is aligned I’ll update HubSpot with the final MAP milestone dates (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/MH-2028-0457).

Appreciate the partnership — we’ll keep the cadence tight and transparent.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0124
